exposure: Elective induction of labor at 39 weeks
cohort: 174 low-risk nulliparous pregnant people who delivered at Brockville General Hospital between September 2018 and December 2021.
finding: Elective induction of labor at 39 weeks gestation in low-risk nulliparous people was associated with lower risks of cesarean delivery, composite adverse maternal outcomes, and composite adverse perinatal outcomes compared to expectant management.
